[spoiler=[b]Military Equipment Sales and Support Agreement[/b]
[i]Between Luscária and Meritava
Date: September 28th, 2027[/i]]

[b]Title I - Scope and Purpose[/b]

[i]Section 1.01 - Scope[/i]
This agreement governs the sale, transfer, delivery, and initial support of military equipment and munitions from the Paramount State of Luscária to the Tsardom of Meritava, which shall henceforth be collectively referred to as the Parties.

[i]Section 1.02 - Purpose[/i]
This agreement aims to deepen long-term defense cooperation between the Parties by enhancing Meritavas national defense capabilities.

[b]Title II - Equipment and Quantities[/b]

Luscária shall supply the following equipment and munitions to Meritava:

[i]Section 2.01 - Aircraft and Naval Platforms[/i]
 60 x J-31 Multirole Fighter Aircraft
 72 x J-10CE Multirole Fighter Aircraft
 5 x KJ-500E Airborne Early Warning & Control Aircraft
 6 x Type 039B Diesel-Electric Submarines

[i]Section 2.02 - Air Defense and Sensor Systems[/i]
 12 x FD-2000B Long-Range Air Defense Batteries
 24 x SLC-7 Radar Systems

[i]Section 2.03 - Munitions[/i]
 600 x PL-15E Air-to-Air Missiles
 400 x YJ-83 Anti-Ship Missiles
 360 x KD-88 Air-to-Surface Missiles

[b]Title III - Financial Terms and Delivery[/b]

[i]Section 3.01 - Pricing[/i]
The Parties acknowledge that the value of this agreement shall be $22.864 billion, based on negotiated rates.

[i]Section 3.02 - Financial Settlement[/i]
The Tsardom of Meritava shall pay the Paramount State of Luscária $2.858 billion on an annual basis for a period of eight (8) years

[i]Section 3.03 - Delivery[/i]
The Paramount State of Luscária shall conduct deliveries in phased batches over a period of eight (8) years.

[b]Title IV - Training and Support[/b]

[i]Section 4.01 - Training and Technical Assistance[/i]
Luscária shall provide initial training, technical assistance, and logistical support necessary for the operational integration of the supplied systems.

[i]Section 4.02 - Maintenance and Support[/i]
Sustainment, spare parts, and future upgrades may be addressed under separate supplementary agreements.

[b]Title V - End-Use and Security[/b]

[i]Section 5.01 - End-Use Agreement[/i]
All equipment supplied under this agreement shall:
1. Be used exclusively by the Armed Forces of Meritava.

2. Not be transferred, sold, gifted, or provided to any third party without the direct approval of Luscária.

3. Only be employed for the legitimate defense and security needs of Meritava and shall not be used in any act of aggression against the armed forces, military assets, or territory of Luscária.

[i]Section 5.02 - Security[/i]
The Tsardom of Meritava shall be responsible for the implementation of appropriate security measures so as to ensure the protection of sensitive technologies.

[b]Title VI - Confidentiality[/b]

The terms, pricing, and technical details of this agreement are to remain confidential unless disclosure is required by domestic law or mutually agreed upon by both Parties.

[b]Title VII - Entry into Effect[/b]

This agreement shall enter into effect upon signature by authorized representatives of both Parties.

[b]Signatures[/b]

[i]Signed on behalf of the Paramount State of Luscária,[/i]
Caudillo Manuel A. Torres

[i]Signed on behalf of the Tsardom of Meritava,[/i]
Tsar Aleksandr I Meritavsky
[/spoiler]
